name: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken
steps: Season chicken cubes with salt, pepper, and half of the Italian herbs.
Melt garlic butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and sear until golden, then cook until the thickest piece reaches 74°C (165°F) internally (about 6–8 minutes, depending on size).
Reduce heat to low and pour in the heavy cream and parmesan cheese, stirring gently.
Simmer for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens into a rich, velvety consistency.
Garnish with fresh parsley and remaining herbs, then serve warm with garlic bread or pasta.
description: ✨ [Chef Special] A luxurious, creamy garlic butter chicken smothered in a rich parmesan sauce that melts in your mouth.

name: Sweet & Crispy Cheesy Toast
steps: Mix softened butter and sugar together in a small bowl until well combined.
Place one slice of bread on a flat surface and lay the cheese sheet on top.
Cover with the second slice of bread to form a sandwich.
Generously spread the sweet butter mixture evenly over the outside of both sides of the sandwich.
Heat a non-stick pan or skillet over low flame.
Place the sandwich on the pan and toast gently until the bottom is golden brown and crisp.
Carefully flip and toast the other side until golden and the cheese inside melts deliciously.
Remove from the pan, cut diagonally, and serve warm.
description: 🌟 [Customer Special] A delightful sweet and savory butter-toasted cheesy toast recipe with crispy golden crust and melted cheese, specially submitted by our community!

name: Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the bread until crisp.
Scoop the avocado into a bowl and mash with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Spread the avocado evenly over the toast.
Drizzle with olive oil and finish with chili flakes.
Serve immediately.
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: A delicious avocado toast recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Banana Oat Bowl
steps: Slice one banana and mash the other.
Combine oats, mashed banana, milk and cinnamon in a saucepan.
Cook over medium-low heat, stirring until creamy.
Divide between bowls.
Top with banana slices, nuts and honey.
Serve warm.
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: A delicious banana oat bowl recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Berry Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon a layer of yogurt into two glasses.
Add a layer of berries and granola.
Repeat the layers until the glasses are full.
Drizzle with honey and chill for 10 minutes.
Serve cold.
description: A delicious berry yogurt parfait recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Breakfast Burrito
steps: Scramble the eggs in a lightly oiled pan, cooking until fully set.
Warm the tortillas.
Layer beans, eggs, tomato, onion and cheese.
Fold the sides and roll tightly.
Toast the burrito seam-side down for 1–2 minutes.
Serve warm.
description: A delicious breakfast burrito recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Chickpea Breakfast Salad
steps: Dice the tomato, cucumber and onion.
Combine the vegetables and chickpeas in a bowl.
Add coriander, lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Toss thoroughly and let it stand for 5 minutes.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: A delicious chickpea breakfast salad recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Cinnamon French Toast Rolls
steps: Trim the bread crusts and flatten each slice with a rolling pin.
Place a thin banana strip near one edge and roll tightly.
Whisk eggs, milk and half the sugar together.
Dip each roll in the mixture.
Cook in butter over medium heat, turning to brown all sides, until the egg coating is fully set and the center is cooked through.
Mix remaining sugar with cinnamon and roll the warm pieces in it.
Serve immediately.
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: A delicious cinnamon french toast rolls recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Classic Pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, melted butter and vanilla until smooth.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry mixture and stir just until combined; a few small lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly buttered non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour about 1/4 cup batter for each pancake and cook until bubbles form on the surface.
Flip and cook for another 1–2 minutes, until golden and cooked through with no wet batter in the center.
Repeat with the remaining batter and serve warm with fruit or syrup.
Food safety: cook the egg mixture until fully set with no raw, liquid egg remaining. Keep raw egg and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat foods.
description: A delicious classic pancakes recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Egg Bhurji
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat oil and sauté onion and chili until soft.
Add tomato, turmeric and chili powder and cook until the tomato breaks down.
Pour in the eggs and stir continuously to form soft curds.
Cook until the egg curds are fully set, then add coriander.
Serve hot with toast or roti.
description: A delicious egg bhurji recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: French Crepes
steps: Whisk all ingredients into a thin, smooth batter.
Rest the batter for 10 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan and lightly grease it.
Pour a small amount of batter and quickly swirl the pan into a thin circle.
Cook until the edges lift and the surface is set, then flip and cook the other side until fully set.
Repeat with the remaining batter and fill with fruit or cream.
description: A delicious french crepes recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon and vanilla in a shallow bowl.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Dip each bread slice briefly into the egg mixture on both sides.
Place the soaked bread in the skillet and cook for 2–3 minutes per side, until the egg mixture is fully set and the center is cooked through.
Continue until all slices are golden.
Serve with fruit, honey or maple syrup.
description: A delicious french toast recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Idli with Coconut Chutney
steps: Grease idli molds lightly.
Pour batter into the molds without filling them completely.
Steam for 10–12 minutes until the idlis are firm.
For chutney, blend coconut, roasted gram, chili, ginger, salt and enough water to make a smooth paste.
Rest the steamed idlis for 2 minutes before removing.
Serve hot with coconut chutney.
description: A delicious idli with coconut chutney recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Masala Dosa
steps: Boil the potatoes, peel them and roughly mash them.
Heat oil, crackle mustard seeds and add curry leaves, onion and chili.
Add turmeric, mashed potatoes and salt; cook for 3 minutes.
Heat a flat pan and spread a ladle of dosa batter into a thin circle.
Drizzle a little oil and cook until the edges turn crisp.
Place potato masala in the center and fold the dosa.
Serve hot with chutney and sambar.
description: A delicious masala dosa recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Masala Omelette
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk until combined.
Add onion, chili, coriander, turmeric, chili powder and salt.
Heat oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and spread it evenly.
Cook until the base is set, then fold the omelette and continue cooking until the center is fully set.
Fold the omelette and cook for another minute.
Serve immediately with toast, roti or salad.
description: A delicious masala omelette recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Rava Dosa
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 cups water, as needed for a thin batter
steps: In a bowl, mix the rava, rice flour, all-purpose flour, cumin seeds, chopped green chili, ginger, coriander leaves, curry leaves, and salt.
Gradually whisk in 2 1/2 cups of water to make a thin, pourable batter. Add a little more water if needed; rava dosa batter should be much thinner than regular dosa batter.
Rest the batter for 15–20 minutes so the rava can hydrate. Stir well before cooking because the flour may settle.
If using onion, stir it into the batter or sprinkle a little onto the pan before pouring each dosa.
Heat a flat non-stick or cast-iron tawa over medium-high heat and lightly grease it.
Stir the batter, then pour it from the outer edge toward the center in a thin layer. Small holes and a lacy pattern are normal; do not spread it with a ladle like regular dosa batter.
Drizzle a little oil or ghee around the edges and cook for 2–4 minutes, until the underside is golden and crisp and the top looks set.

Carefully loosen the edges and flip the dosa if needed; cook the second side for about 30–60 seconds. For a very crisp traditional-style rava dosa, it can also be cooked on one side until fully crisp.
Repeat with the remaining batter, stirring it before each dosa and adjusting with a splash of water if it thickens.
Serve hot with coconut chutney and sambar.
description: Crispy, lacy South Indian rava dosa made with semolina and rice flour. The thin batter is poured onto a hot tawa rather than spread, giving the dosa its signature texture.

name: Vegetable Poha
steps: Rinse the flattened rice briefly and let it drain without making it mushy.
Heat oil and crackle mustard seeds; add peanuts and toast them.
Add onion and chili and cook until soft.
Add peas and turmeric and cook until the peas are tender.
Add the drained poha and salt and gently mix.
Cook for 3–4 minutes over low heat.
Finish with lemon juice and serve warm.
description: A delicious vegetable poha recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Vegetable Upma
steps: Dry-roast the semolina over low heat until lightly fragrant, then set aside.
Heat oil and crackle the mustard seeds; add curry leaves and chili.
Add onion and cook until translucent.
Add carrot and peas and cook for 3–4 minutes.
Pour in water and add salt; bring to a boil.
Lower the heat and slowly add semolina while stirring continuously.
Cook until thick and fluffy, then rest for 3 minutes before serving.
description: A delicious vegetable upma recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Aloo Gobi
steps: Wash and cut the cauliflower and potato into bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds.
Add onion and cook until softened, then stir in ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato, turmeric, coriander powder, chili powder and salt; cook until the tomato softens.
Add potato and a splash of water, cover and cook until nearly tender.
Add cauliflower, mix gently, cover and cook until both vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.
Garnish with coriander and serve with rice or chapati.
description: Detailed aloo gobi recipe with measured ingredients and clear step-by-step instructions.

name: Caesar Salad
steps: Wash and dry the lettuce thoroughly.
Chop lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
Whisk mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, garlic and olive oil into a dressing.
Season the dressing with salt and pepper.
Toss lettuce with the dressing.
Add parmesan and croutons and toss gently.
Serve immediately.
description: A delicious caesar salad recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Use rice that was cooled quickly and refrigerated promptly; keep it cold until frying. Do not use rice left at room temperature for a long time.
Cut raw chicken into small, even pieces and season lightly. Wash hands and utensils after handling raw chicken.
Heat oil in a wok and cook the chicken, stirring, until the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F) internally. Transfer to a clean plate.
Stir-fry onion, garlic, carrot and peas until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Push the vegetables aside and scramble the eggs until fully set.
Add the cold cooked rice and break up any clumps. Stir-fry until steaming hot throughout.
Return the cooked chicken to the wok, add soy sauce and black pepper, and toss for 2–3 minutes until everything is hot. Serve immediately.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: A delicious chicken fried rice recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Chicken Wrap
steps: Use properly refrigerated, fully cooked chicken. Wash hands and use separate clean utensils and boards for ready-to-eat vegetables; slice the chicken and vegetables separately.
Mix yogurt, lemon juice and paprika to make a quick sauce.
Warm the tortillas for 20 seconds per side.
Spread sauce over each tortilla.
Add lettuce, vegetables and chicken.
Fold the sides inward and roll tightly.
Slice in half and serve.
description: A delicious chicken wrap recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Chickpea Salad Wrap
steps: Mash half of the chickpeas lightly and leave the rest whole.
Mix with yogurt, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Add diced cucumber and tomato.
Warm the tortillas.
Add lettuce and the chickpea mixture.
Roll tightly and serve.
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: A delicious chickpea salad wrap recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Creamy Garlic Pasta
steps: Boil salted water and cook pasta until al dente.
Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain the pasta.
Melt butter and gently cook garlic for one minute.
Add cream and simmer for 2–3 minutes.
Stir in parmesan, salt and pepper until creamy.
Add pasta and toss; loosen with reserved pasta water if needed.
Finish with parsley and serve hot.
description: A delicious creamy garlic pasta recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Greek Salad
steps: Cut tomatoes and cucumber into chunks.
Thinly slice the onion.
Combine vegetables and olives in a bowl.
Add feta in small cubes.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice and oregano.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss gently.
Serve immediately.
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: A delicious greek salad recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Jeera Rice
steps: Rinse the basmati rice until the water runs mostly clear, then soak for 15–20 minutes and drain.
Heat ghee or oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them crackle without burning.
Add the bay leaf, cardamom, cloves and cinnamon; stir for a few seconds until fragrant.
Add the drained rice and stir gently for 1–2 minutes to coat the grains.
Add 1 1/2 cups water and salt; bring to a boil. Add a little more water if needed for your rice.
Cover and cook on low heat until the rice is tender and the water is absorbed, about 12–18 minutes.
Turn off the heat and rest covered for 5 minutes, then fluff gently and garnish with coriander.
description: Fragrant basmati rice tempered with cumin seeds and a few whole spices.

name: Lentil Soup
steps: Rinse the lentils thoroughly.
Heat oil and sauté onion, carrot and garlic.
Add tomatoes and cumin and cook for 2 minutes.
Add lentils and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
Cook for 25–30 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Blend partially if you prefer a creamier texture and season to taste.
description: A delicious lentil soup recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Minestrone Soup
ingredients: 1 cup chopped tomatoes or canned tomatoes
1 cup cooked kidney beans or cannellini beans, drained
steps: Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté onion, carrot and celery until softened.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the chopped tomatoes and Italian herbs, then cook for 2–3 minutes.
Add mixed vegetables and vegetable stock; bring to a gentle boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer until the vegetables are nearly tender, about 10–15 minutes.
Add the cooked beans and small pasta. Simmer until the pasta is cooked according to its packet instructions, adding a little extra stock or water if the soup gets too thick.
Season with salt and black pepper, then serve hot with Parmesan if desired.
description: A hearty Italian-style vegetable soup with tomatoes, beans, small pasta and herbs.

name: Pesto Chicken Pasta
steps: Cook pasta in salted water until al dente and reserve some pasta water.
Season the chicken. Heat oil in a pan and cook the chicken pieces until the thickest part reaches 74°C (165°F) internally.
Rest briefly, then slice the chicken on a clean cutting board.
Toss the drained pasta with pesto and a splash of reserved pasta water.
Add the cooked chicken and parmesan. Toss until evenly coated.
Season with pepper and serve hot.
description: A delicious pesto chicken pasta recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Pesto Penne
steps: Boil penne in salted water until al dente.
Reserve a little pasta water and drain.
Return pasta to the warm pot.
Add pesto and olive oil and toss.
Add parmesan and loosen with a splash of pasta water.
Season with pepper and serve.
description: A delicious pesto penne recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Tomato Basil Pasta
steps: Cook pasta in salted water until al dente.
Heat olive oil and gently sauté garlic.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Season with salt and pepper.
Add drained pasta and toss with the tomato sauce.
Stir in basil and parmesan.
Serve immediately.
description: A delicious tomato basil pasta recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Tuna Sandwich
steps: Drain the tuna well.
Mix tuna with mayonnaise, lemon juice and onion.
Season with pepper and a little salt if needed.
Toast the bread lightly.
Layer lettuce, tomato and tuna mixture.
Close the sandwich and cut in half.
Use unopened, in-date canned tuna; keep the tuna and mayonnaise chilled until assembly and serve immediately. Refrigerate leftovers promptly.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flakes easily; where using a thermometer, check the thickest part reaches 63°C (145°F). Cook prawns and other shellfish until fully opaque and cooked through.
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: A delicious tuna sandwich recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil in a wok.
Stir-fry garlic and vegetables until crisp-tender.
Add cooked rice that was cooled quickly and refrigerated promptly; do not use rice left at room temperature for a long time. Break up clumps.
Add soy sauce and toss over high heat.
Toss and stir-fry until the rice is steaming hot throughout, then serve immediately.
Serve hot.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: A delicious vegetable fried rice recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Vegetable Noodles
steps: Cook noodles according to the packet instructions and drain.
Heat oil in a wok.
Stir-fry garlic and vegetables over high heat.
Add cooked noodles.
Pour in soy sauce and sesame oil.
Toss continuously for 2–3 minutes.
Serve hot.
description: A delicious vegetable noodles recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Veggie Burrito Bowl
steps: Warm the rice and black beans separately.
Dice tomato and avocado.
Season beans with cumin and a pinch of salt.
Divide rice between bowls.
Arrange beans, corn, lettuce, tomato and avocado over the rice.
Drizzle with lime juice.
Serve warm.

Food safety: use freshly cooked rice or rice cooled promptly and kept refrigerated; never use rice left at room temperature for a long time. Reheat until steaming hot throughout and serve immediately.
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: A delicious veggie burrito bowl recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Beef Pepper Fry
steps: Cut beef into bite-sized pieces and mix with turmeric, chili powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt.

Put the beef in a pressure cooker with enough water to prevent scorching. Cook according to the cooker instructions until the beef is fork-tender; allow pressure to release safely before opening. Alternatively, simmer covered in a pot, adding water as needed, until tender.
Heat coconut oil in a wide pan. Add curry leaves and sliced onion and cook until the onion is browned.
Add the cooked beef and a little of its cooking liquid if needed. Stir-fry until most moisture evaporates.
Add freshly crushed black pepper and cook for another 3–4 minutes, stirring so it does not burn.
Check that the beef is tender, then serve hot.

Food safety: cook meat thoroughly. For ground beef or mutton, verify an internal temperature of at least 71°C (160°F); for whole pieces in curries, cook until fully tender and steaming hot throughout.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: A delicious beef pepper fry recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, chili powder, turmeric and salt for at least 30 minutes in the refrigerator.
Cook the chicken in a hot pan until browned and the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F) internally; set aside on a clean plate.
Melt butter and sauté onion until soft.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for about 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes and cook until soft, then blend carefully into a smooth sauce.
Return the sauce to the pan and add garam masala.
Stir in cream and the cooked chicken.
Simmer gently for about 5–10 minutes until piping hot, then garnish with coriander.
description: A delicious butter chicken recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Heat oil and crackle cumin.
Add onion and cook until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomatoes and spices and cook until thick.
Add chickpeas and 1/2 cup water.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add garam masala and serve with rice or roti.
description: A delicious chana masala recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Chicken Alfredo
steps: Cook fettuccine until al dente and reserve some pasta water.
Season the chicken and cook in a pan until the thickest part reaches 74°C (165°F) internally.
Transfer the chicken to a clean plate, rest briefly and slice.
Melt butter in the pan and sauté garlic briefly without browning it.
Add cream and simmer gently.
Stir in parmesan until smooth.
Add pasta and cooked chicken and toss.
Loosen with reserved pasta water if needed, heat until piping hot and serve.
description: A delicious chicken alfredo recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Chicken Korma
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste and salt. Keep it refrigerated while marinating.
Soak cashews in warm water for 15 minutes, then blend with a little fresh water into a smooth paste.
Heat oil and cook sliced onion until golden.
Add chicken and cook, stirring, until the outside is no longer raw.
Add coriander and cumin powder.
Add cashew paste and enough water to make a sauce.
Cover and simmer gently until the chicken is tender and the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F) internally.
Stir in cream and simmer for 3 minutes before serving hot.
description: A delicious chicken korma recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Mix chicken with yogurt, lemon juice, paprika, cumin and salt. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Cook chicken pieces in a hot pan until browned and the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F) internally. Set aside on a clean plate.
Sauté onion in oil until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
Blend the tomato mixture carefully into a smooth sauce.
Return the sauce to the pan and add garam masala.
Add the cooked chicken and cream.
Simmer gently for about 5 minutes until piping hot, then serve with rice or naan.
description: A delicious chicken tikka masala recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Coconut Fish Curry
steps: Heat oil and cook onion until soft.
Add tomatoes, turmeric and chili powder. Cook until the tomatoes form a thick sauce.
Add coconut milk and tamarind and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add fish pieces carefully and cover the pan.
Simmer gently until the fish is opaque and flakes easily, checking that the thickest part reaches 63°C (145°F) with a food thermometer.
Avoid vigorous stirring so the fish pieces remain intact. Serve hot with rice.
description: A delicious coconut fish curry recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Dal Makhani
ingredients: 1 cup whole black urad dal, soaked overnight
1 tsp chili powder, or to taste
steps: Drain and rinse the soaked dal and kidney beans.

Pressure-cook the soaked urad dal and kidney beans in fresh water according to the pressure cooker manufacturer's instructions until completely soft. If unsure whether the kidney beans are fully cooked, cook them separately until fully tender before adding; never use raw or only-soaked kidney beans.
Heat oil and butter in a pan. Add cumin, then onion, and cook until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes; cook until soft and pulpy.
Stir in chili powder, garam masala and salt.
Add the cooked dal and beans with some cooking liquid. Simmer gently, stirring often, until creamy.
Stir in milk or cream if using, adjust the consistency with water, and serve hot with rice or roti.
Pressure-cooker safety: follow the cooker manufacturer's instructions and let pressure release fully before opening; never force the lid open.
description: Detailed dal makhani recipe with measured ingredients and clear step-by-step instructions.

name: Dal Tadka
steps: Rinse lentils and cook with turmeric and enough water until soft.
Mash the cooked lentils lightly.
Heat ghee and crackle cumin.
Add garlic and onion and cook until golden.
Add tomatoes and chili powder and cook until soft.
Pour the tempering into the lentils.
Simmer for 5 minutes and adjust salt.
description: A delicious dal tadka recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Fish Curry
steps: Season fish lightly with turmeric and salt.
Heat oil and sauté onion until soft.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook briefly.
Add tomatoes, turmeric and chili powder and cook until soft.
Add coconut milk and tamarind and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add fish pieces carefully and cover.
Cook gently until the fish is opaque and flakes easily; check the thickest part reaches 63°C (145°F) with a food thermometer. Timing varies with the type and thickness of fish.
Avoid stirring aggressively; gently swirl the pan and serve hot.
description: A delicious fish curry recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Grilled Chicken
steps: Pound chicken to an even thickness.
Mix oil, lemon juice, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Coat chicken and marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Heat grill or grill pan.
Cook chicken for 5–7 minutes per side depending on thickness.
Check that the thickest part reaches 74°C (165°F) internally.
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
description: A delicious grilled chicken recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Kadai Paneer
ingredients: 1 tsp chili powder, or to taste
steps: Cut paneer and capsicum into bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds.
Add onion and cook until lightly golden. Stir in ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomatoes, coriander powder, turmeric, chili powder and salt. Cook until tomatoes soften.
Add capsicum and a small splash of water; cook until just tender.
Add paneer and garam masala, toss gently and warm through without breaking the paneer.
Garnish with coriander and serve with roti, chapati or rice.
description: Detailed kadai paneer recipe with measured ingredients and clear step-by-step instructions.

name: Margherita Pizza
steps: Preheat oven to its highest practical temperature.
Stretch dough into a thin round on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly, leaving a small edge.
Add mozzarella and a little salt.
Bake until the crust is golden and cheese is bubbling.
Top with basil and olive oil.
Slice and serve hot.
description: A delicious margherita pizza recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Mutton Curry
steps: Marinate mutton with turmeric, chili powder and salt.
Heat oil and sauté onion until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook briefly.
Add tomatoes and spice powders and cook until the tomatoes soften and the mixture thickens.
Add mutton and stir to coat with the masala.

Add enough water to partially cover the meat. Cover and simmer gently, or pressure-cook according to the cooker instructions, until the mutton is fork-tender. Add water if needed and allow pressure to release safely before opening.
Open the lid and reduce the gravy to your preferred thickness.
Finish with garam masala and serve hot.

Food safety: cook meat thoroughly. For ground beef or mutton, verify an internal temperature of at least 71°C (160°F); for whole pieces in curries, cook until fully tender and steaming hot throughout.
description: A delicious mutton curry recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes and immediately cool it in cold water.
Blend spinach with green chili into a smooth puree.
Sauté paneer cubes lightly and set aside.
Heat oil and sauté cumin, onion and garlic.
Add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add spinach puree and simmer gently.
Add paneer and cream.
Cook for 5 minutes and season to taste.
description: A delicious palak paneer recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Cut paneer into cubes.
Lightly brown paneer in a little butter and set aside.
Sauté onion until soft, then add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomatoes and chili powder and cook until soft.
Blend into a smooth sauce.
Return the sauce to the pan and add garam masala.
Add cream and paneer cubes.
Simmer gently for 5–7 minutes and serve.
description: A delicious paneer butter masala recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Rajma Masala
steps: Heat oil and crackle cumin.
Add onion and cook until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, turmeric and chili powder.
Cook until the tomatoes become a thick paste.
Add kidney beans and one cup water.
Simmer for 15–20 minutes so the flavors combine.
Add garam masala and adjust salt before serving.

Use only fully cooked kidney beans. If starting with dried rajma, soak according to package guidance, discard the soaking water, and boil in fresh water until completely tender before adding; never eat raw or merely soaked kidney beans.
description: A delicious rajma masala recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Shahi Paneer
steps: Soak cashews in warm water for 10 minutes, then blend with tomatoes until smooth.
Heat oil or ghee in a pan and cook onion until soft and golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook briefly.
Add the tomato-cashew puree, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder and salt. Simmer until thickened.
Stir in milk and a little water if needed to make a smooth gravy.
Add paneer and garam masala; simmer gently for a few minutes until warmed through.
Garnish with coriander and serve with rice or chapati.
description: Detailed shahi paneer recipe with measured ingredients and clear step-by-step instructions.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 250 g minced chicken, if using chicken
1 1/2 cups cooked lentils, if using the vegetarian option
1/4 cup water for the baking dish
steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C (375°F). Cut the tops from the peppers and remove the seeds.
Sauté onion and tomato until soft.
For the chicken option, add minced chicken and cook, breaking it up, until no longer raw; for the vegetarian option, stir in cooked lentils and heat through.
Stir in cooked rice, paprika, salt and pepper.
Fill each pepper with the mixture and place them upright in a baking dish with 1/4 cup water.
Cover and bake for about 30 minutes, until the peppers begin to soften.
Remove the cover and add cheese. Bake another 8–10 minutes, until melted. If using minced chicken, check the centre of the filling reaches 74°C (165°F).

Food safety: use freshly cooked rice or rice cooled promptly and kept refrigerated; never use rice left at room temperature for a long time. Reheat until steaming hot throughout and serve immediately.
description: A delicious stuffed bell peppers recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Tandoori Chicken
steps: Make a few shallow cuts in the chicken so the marinade can coat it.
Mix yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, spices, oil and salt.
Coat chicken thoroughly, cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Heat oven to 220°C and place chicken on a lined tray or rack.
Bake, turning once, until cooked through and the thickest part reaches 75°C; timing depends on piece size.
Rest briefly and serve with lemon and sliced onion.
Food safety: cook all chicken, including the thickest pieces, to an internal temperature of 74°C (165°F), checked with a clean food thermometer. Do not rely on colour alone.
description: Detailed tandoori chicken recipe with measured ingredients and clear step-by-step instructions.

name: Teriyaki Chicken
steps: Whisk soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces on a separate board from ready-to-eat foods.
Cook chicken in a hot pan until browned and the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F) internally.
Pour in the sauce and simmer for 2–3 minutes.
Mix cornstarch with a tablespoon of cold water and stir it in.
Cook until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Serve hot with rice and vegetables.
description: A delicious teriyaki chicken recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Thai Green Curry
steps: Heat oil in a deep pan and fry the green curry paste for 1 minute.
Add half the coconut milk and simmer until fragrant.
If using chicken, add it and simmer until the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F) internally before adding the vegetables. If using tofu, add it with the vegetables in the next step.
Add the remaining coconut milk, bell pepper and broccoli. Simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Season with soy sauce and sugar.
Finish with a small handful of basil leaves and serve over steamed rice.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: A delicious thai green curry recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Vegetable Curry
steps: Cut all vegetables into similar-sized pieces.
Heat oil and sauté onion until soft.
Add tomatoes and cook until they break down.
Add turmeric, chili powder and garam masala.
Add vegetables and stir to coat.
Pour in coconut milk and a little water.
Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and serve with rice or flatbread.
description: A delicious vegetable curry recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Beef Biryani
steps: Rinse the basmati rice and soak for 20–30 minutes, then drain.
Heat some of the ghee in a heavy pot. Cook sliced onions until golden; reserve some for layering if desired.
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, biryani masala and salt. Cook until the tomatoes soften.
Add beef and stir to coat. Add about 2–3 cups water, cover and simmer gently until the beef is fork-tender, adding water as needed. Do not start layering until the beef is tender.
In a separate large pot, bring plenty of salted water to a boil. Add the drained rice and boil until it is about 70% cooked: the outside is soft but the centre remains firm. Drain immediately.
Layer the cooked beef masala and par-cooked rice in the heavy pot. Sprinkle mint, coriander and the reserved fried onions between or over the layers.
Drizzle the remaining ghee over the rice. Cover tightly; use foil under the lid if it does not seal well.
Cook on the lowest heat for 20–25 minutes, using a heat diffuser or tawa under the pot to prevent scorching. Turn off the heat and rest, covered, for 10 minutes.
Check that the rice is tender and the beef remains hot throughout. Gently lift the layers together and serve hot.

Food safety: cook meat thoroughly. For ground beef or mutton, verify an internal temperature of at least 71°C (160°F); for whole pieces in curries, cook until fully tender and steaming hot throughout.
description: A delicious Beef Biryani recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Chicken Biryani
steps: Rinse the basmati rice, soak for 20–30 minutes, then drain.
Marinate the chicken with yogurt, biryani masala, ginger-garlic paste and salt. Keep refrigerated while marinating.
Heat some ghee in a heavy pot and cook sliced onions until golden. Add tomatoes and cook until softened.
Add the marinated chicken and cook until the outside is no longer raw and the masala thickens. Add a little water if needed; ensure the chicken reaches 74°C (165°F) internally before serving.
In a separate large pot, bring plenty of salted water to a boil. Add the drained rice and boil until about 70% cooked: soft outside with a firm centre. Drain immediately.
Layer the chicken masala and par-cooked rice in the heavy pot. Scatter mint and coriander over the rice and drizzle with the remaining ghee.
Cover tightly; use foil under the lid if needed to help seal in steam.
Cook on the lowest heat for 20–25 minutes, using a heat diffuser or tawa under the pot to prevent scorching. Turn off the heat and rest, covered, for 10 minutes.
Check that the rice is tender and the chicken is fully cooked and piping hot. Serve immediately.
description: A delicious Chicken Biryani recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Egg Biryani
steps: Cook rice until 70% done.
Prepare onion-tomato biryani masala.
Add boiled eggs and coat gently with masala.
Layer masala and rice with herbs and ghee.
Cover and dum-cook for 10–15 minutes.
Food safety: cook the egg mixture until fully set with no raw, liquid egg remaining. Keep raw egg and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat foods.
description: A delicious Egg Biryani recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
steps: Marinate the chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, biryani masala and salt. Keep refrigerated until you are ready to cook.
Rinse and soak the basmati rice for 20–30 minutes, then drain.
Fry sliced onions in the oil or ghee until golden. Reserve some for layering.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the rice until about 70% done: soft on the outside but still firm in the centre. Drain immediately.
Place the marinated raw chicken in a heavy-bottomed pot and spread it evenly. Add a little water only if needed to prevent sticking.
Layer the par-cooked rice over the chicken. Add herbs, reserved fried onions and saffron as available.
Cover tightly, using foil under the lid if needed. Cook on the lowest heat for about 35–45 minutes; use a heat diffuser or tawa to reduce scorching. The time depends on the chicken pieces and pot.
Check the thickest chicken pieces with a food thermometer; they must reach 74°C (165°F), and the rice must be fully tender. If not, cover and continue cooking, checking again.
Rest covered for 10 minutes, then gently mix the layers and serve hot.
description: A delicious Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Malabar Fish Biryani
steps: Rinse the jeerakasala rice and soak it for 20–30 minutes, then drain.
Season the fish with turmeric, chili powder and salt. Shallow-fry until partly cooked and lightly browned; set aside carefully.
Heat some ghee in a heavy pan. Cook sliced onions until golden, then add ginger-garlic paste and cook briefly.
Add tomatoes and the listed spices, and cook until the tomatoes soften into a thick masala.
In a separate pot, cook the rice in salted water until nearly tender but still slightly firm. Drain well.
Gently fold the fish into the masala without breaking the pieces.
Layer the fish masala and rice in a heavy-bottomed pot. Scatter mint, coriander and a little ghee between or over the layers.
Cover tightly and dum-cook on the lowest heat for about 10–15 minutes, then rest covered for 5–10 minutes. Avoid prolonged cooking so the fish does not become tough.
Check the thickest piece of fish reaches 63°C (145°F) internally and that the rice is fully tender. Serve hot.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: A delicious Malabar Fish Biryani recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Mutton Biryani
steps: Rinse the basmati rice and soak for 20–30 minutes, then drain.
Heat some ghee in a heavy pot and cook sliced onions until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, yogurt, biryani masala and salt; cook until the tomatoes soften.
Add the mutton and stir to coat with the masala. Add enough water to cook the meat without scorching.

Cover and simmer gently, or pressure-cook according to the cooker instructions, until the mutton is fork-tender. Allow pressure to release safely before opening. Do not layer the rice until the mutton is tender.
In a separate pot, bring plenty of salted water to a boil. Add the drained rice and cook until about 70% done; drain immediately.
Layer the mutton masala and par-cooked rice in the heavy pot. Add mint, coriander and ghee between or over the layers.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 20–25 minutes, using a heat diffuser or tawa to prevent scorching.
Turn off the heat and rest covered for 10 minutes. Check that the rice is fully tender and the mutton is hot and tender, then serve.

Food safety: cook meat thoroughly. For ground beef or mutton, verify an internal temperature of at least 71°C (160°F); for whole pieces in curries, cook until fully tender and steaming hot throughout.
description: A delicious Mutton Biryani recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Thalassery Chicken Biryani
steps: Wash the jeerakasala rice and soak for 20–30 minutes, then drain.
Heat some ghee in a heavy pot and cook sliced onions until golden. Reserve some for layering.
Add ginger-garlic paste, green chilies, tomatoes, yogurt and whole spices. Cook until the tomatoes soften.
Add chicken and cook in the masala until the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F) internally. Add a little water if needed so the masala does not scorch.
In a separate pot, cook the rice in salted water until nearly tender but still slightly firm in the centre; drain well.
Layer the cooked chicken masala and rice in the heavy pot. Add mint, coriander, reserved fried onions and ghee over the layers.
Cover tightly and dum-cook on the lowest heat for 10–15 minutes, using a heat diffuser or tawa to prevent burning.
Rest covered for 10 minutes. Check that the rice is fully tender and the chicken remains piping hot, then serve.
description: A delicious Thalassery Chicken Biryani recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Vegetable Biryani
steps: Rinse the basmati rice and soak for 20–30 minutes, then drain.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the rice until about 70% done, with a firm centre, then drain immediately.
Heat ghee in a heavy pan and cook sliced onions until softened and lightly golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, yogurt and biryani masala. Cook until the tomatoes soften and the masala thickens.
Add mixed vegetables and cook with a splash of water until they are nearly tender. Season with salt.
Layer the vegetable masala and par-cooked rice in a heavy pot. Add mint and coriander between the layers and drizzle with ghee.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 15–20 minutes, using a heat diffuser or tawa to prevent scorching.
Rest covered for 5–10 minutes. Check the rice and vegetables are fully tender, then gently mix and serve.
description: A delicious Vegetable Biryani recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Avial
steps: Cook mixed vegetables with salt and a little water until tender.
Grind coconut, green chilies and cumin into a coarse paste.
Mix the coconut paste into the vegetables and cook gently.
Turn off the heat and mix in yogurt.
Finish with coconut oil and curry leaves.
description: A Kerala-style mixed vegetable dish simmered with coconut, green chilli and yogurt.

name: Idiyappam
steps: Mix the rice flour and salt in a heatproof bowl.
Bring the water to a boil, then gradually add it to the flour while mixing with a spoon. Use only enough water to make a soft, smooth dough; the exact amount varies by flour.
When cool enough to handle, knead briefly until smooth. Grease the idiyappam press lightly.
Fill the press and squeeze the dough into small nests on greased idli plates or steamer trays. Sprinkle a little grated coconut over each nest if desired.
Steam over actively simmering water for about 8–10 minutes, until the strands are cooked through and no longer taste raw.
Let stand for a minute before removing carefully. Serve warm with coconut and curry or stew.
description: A delicious Idiyappam recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Kadala Curry
steps: Cook chickpeas until tender.
Roast coconut with cumin and spices, then grind to a paste.
Cook onion and add the coconut paste.
Add chickpeas and simmer until thick.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil and add on top.
description: A delicious Kadala Curry recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Kalan
steps: Cook banana and yam with turmeric and salt.
Grind coconut, cumin and chilies.
Add the coconut paste and cook briefly.
Lower the heat and mix in whisked sour yogurt.
Temper fenugreek and curry leaves in coconut oil and add.
description: A delicious Kalan recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Kerala Chicken Curry
steps: Heat coconut oil in a pan and sauté the onions until soft.
Add ginger-garlic paste and the turmeric, chili and coriander powders. Stir briefly without burning the spices.
Add chicken and stir to coat with the masala.
Add tomatoes and coconut milk. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is tender and the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F) internally.
Finish with curry leaves, adjust salt and serve hot.
description: A delicious Kerala Chicken Curry recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Kerala Fish Curry
steps: Soak the tamarind in warm water and extract the juice, removing any seeds or fibres.
Mix the chili powder and turmeric with a little water to make a paste. Crush or finely chop the ginger and garlic.
Heat coconut oil and briefly sauté the ginger and garlic, then add the spice paste and cook gently without burning it.
Add tamarind water and salt. Bring to a simmer and cook for a few minutes to mellow the raw spice taste.
Add the fish pieces and simmer gently, covered, until opaque and flaky. Check the thickest piece reaches 63°C (145°F) internally; cooking time varies by fish thickness.
Finish with curry leaves and serve hot.
description: Tangy Kerala fish curry simmered with chilli, turmeric, tamarind and curry leaves.

name: Kerala Thoran
steps: Mix vegetables with turmeric and salt.
Cook covered with a splash of water.
Grind coconut, chili and cumin coarsely.
Add coconut mixture and cook briefly.
Temper mustard and curry leaves in coconut oil and mix in.
description: A delicious Kerala Thoran recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Kerala Vegetable Stew
steps: Cook vegetables with onion, chilies and whole spices.
Add thin coconut milk and simmer until vegetables are tender.
Add thick coconut milk and heat gently.
Do not boil vigorously after adding thick coconut milk.
Finish with coconut oil and curry leaves.
description: A delicious Kerala Vegetable Stew recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Olan
steps: Cook ash gourd with green chilies and salt.
Add cooked black-eyed peas and thin coconut milk.
Simmer gently until flavors combine.
Add thick coconut milk without boiling hard.
Finish with coconut oil and curry leaves.
description: A delicious Olan recipe with clear ingredients and step-by-step cooking instructions.

name: Parotta
ingredients: 2 tbsp oil, plus extra for resting and cooking
3/4 cup water, added gradually as needed
steps: Mix the flour, sugar and salt in a bowl.
Add oil and gradually add water, kneading until a smooth, soft and elastic dough forms.
Cover and rest the dough for at least 2 hours so the gluten relaxes and the dough stretches easily.
Divide into 4 equal balls, coat each with oil and rest for another 20–30 minutes.
On an oiled surface, stretch each ball into a very thin sheet, then pleat or fold it into long layers and coil into a spiral.
Rest the coils for 10 minutes, then gently roll each into a flat round without pressing out all the layers.
Cook on a hot tawa with a little oil, turning until both sides are golden and cooked through.
Carefully clap or press the cooked parotta between your hands to loosen the layers, and serve hot.
description: Soft, flaky Kerala-style layered flatbread made by stretching, coiling and pan-cooking an elastic dough.

name: Pazham Pori
steps: Peel the plantains and slice them lengthwise into even pieces.
Mix all-purpose flour, rice flour, sugar and turmeric with water to make a thick, smooth batter that coats the slices.
Heat frying oil to about 170–180°C (340–355°F).
Dip each plantain slice in the batter, let excess drip off, and carefully lower it into the oil.
Fry in small batches, turning as needed, until the coating is golden and crisp and the plantain is tender.
Drain on a rack or paper towel and serve warm.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: Ripe plantain slices coated in a lightly sweetened batter and fried until golden.

name: Aloo Tikki
steps: Boil and mash potatoes.
Mix with cumin, chili powder, coriander, breadcrumbs and salt.
Shape into flat patties.
Heat oil in a pan.
Cook patties on both sides until crisp and golden.
Serve with chutney.
description: A delicious aloo tikki recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Cheese Garlic Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Mix softened butter with crushed garlic, parsley and salt.
Slice the baguette without cutting all the way through.
Spread garlic butter between the slices.
Add mozzarella over the bread.
Bake for 8–10 minutes until the cheese melts and edges crisp.
Serve hot.
description: A delicious cheese garlic bread recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Heat a pan and lightly butter one side of a tortilla.
Place tortilla butter-side down.
Add cheese, sliced pepper and onion.
Top with the second tortilla.
Cook until the bottom is golden.
Flip carefully and cook until the cheese melts.
Slice into wedges and serve.
description: A delicious cheese quesadilla recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Chicken 65
ingredients: 1 tsp chili powder, or to taste
Oil for shallow or deep frying
steps: Mix chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, rice flour, cornflour, spices and salt.
Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook chicken in batches until crisp and the center reaches 74°C (165°F), avoiding overcrowding.
In a separate pan, warm a little oil and briefly fry curry leaves.
Toss cooked chicken with curry leaves and serve hot.
description: Detailed chicken 65 recipe with measured ingredients and clear step-by-step instructions.

name: Chicken Nuggets
steps: Cut chicken into small nugget-sized pieces.
Season flour with paprika, salt and pepper.
Coat chicken in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Heat oil over medium heat.
Fry nuggets in batches until golden and the center reaches 74°C (165°F) internally.
Drain well and serve with your favorite dip.
description: A delicious chicken nuggets recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Chicken Samosa
steps: Shred the cooked chicken finely.
Sauté onion and green chili until soft.
Add chicken, garam masala, coriander and salt.

Add the cooked chicken, garam masala, coriander and salt; heat until steaming hot (74°C/165°F if checking with a thermometer). Transfer to a shallow dish and cool promptly; refrigerate if not assembling right away, and do not leave at room temperature for over 2 hours (1 hour in hot weather).
Fill each wrapper and fold into a triangular parcel.
Seal the edge with a flour-water paste.
Fry over medium heat until crisp and golden.
Drain and serve with chutney.
description: A delicious chicken samosa recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Corn Chaat
steps: Cook or steam the corn until tender.
Dice tomato and onion.
Combine corn, tomato, onion and coriander.
Add lemon juice, chaat masala and salt.
Toss well and serve immediately.
description: A delicious corn chaat recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Corn Cheese Balls
steps: Mash the boiled potato until smooth.
Mix potato, corn, cheese, breadcrumbs, pepper and salt.
Shape the mixture into small balls.
Chill for 15 minutes so they firm up.
Fry or air-fry until golden.
Drain and serve with tomato or chili sauce.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: A delicious corn cheese balls recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Crispy French Fries
steps: Peel the potatoes and cut them into even strips.
Rinse several times and soak in cold water for 15 minutes.
Drain and dry the strips very thoroughly to reduce oil splatter.
Heat frying oil to about 160°C (320°F). Fry the potatoes in batches until pale and tender but not browned.
Remove and rest for several minutes. Let the oil return to temperature between batches.
Increase the oil temperature to about 190°C (375°F) and fry again in batches until golden and crisp.
Drain and season immediately with salt, paprika and pepper.
description: A delicious crispy french fries recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Hummus with Pita
steps: Drain and rinse chickpeas.
Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic and cumin.
Add a little cold water while blending until smooth.
Season with salt.
Spread hummus in a bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
Serve with warm pita.
description: A delicious hummus with pita recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Medu Vada
steps: Soak urad dal for 4 hours, then drain very thoroughly.
Grind with as little water as possible into a thick, fluffy batter. The batter should hold its shape rather than pour.
Mix in chili, cumin, coriander and salt.
Heat oil to about 170–175°C (340–350°F). Wet your hands, shape small rings and carefully slide them into the oil.
Fry in batches, turning as needed, until golden and cooked through in the centre. Keep the heat moderate so the outside does not brown before the inside cooks.
Drain and serve hot with chutney or sambar.
description: Detailed medu vada recipe with measured ingredients and step-by-step instructions.

name: Nachos
ingredients: 1 cup cooked kidney beans or black beans
steps: Heat oil in a pan and cook onion until softened.
Add cooked beans, corn, tomato, chili powder, cumin and salt; cook for 3–4 minutes.
Spread tortilla chips on an oven-safe plate or tray and spoon the bean mixture over them.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top.
Bake at 180°C just until the cheese melts, or heat briefly in a covered pan on low heat.
Garnish with coriander and serve immediately.
description: Detailed nachos recipe with measured ingredients and clear step-by-step instructions.

name: Onion Rings
steps: Slice the onions into thick rings and separate them.
Mix flour, cornstarch, paprika and salt in a bowl.
Whisk in cold water gradually to make a thick batter that coats a ring.
Heat oil to about 175°C (350°F).
Dip each onion ring into the batter, let excess drip off and carefully lower it into the oil.
Fry in small batches until golden and crisp, turning as needed and allowing the oil to return to temperature between batches.
Drain on a rack or paper towel and serve hot.
description: A delicious onion rings recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Paneer Tikka
steps: Cut paneer and vegetables into large cubes.
Mix yogurt with spices, lemon juice and salt.
Coat paneer and vegetables thoroughly.
Marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or bake at 220°C until lightly charred.
Turn once during cooking and serve hot.
description: A delicious paneer tikka recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Pav Bhaji
ingredients: 1/2 tsp chili powder, or to taste
steps: Boil potatoes, cauliflower and peas until soft; drain and mash roughly.
Heat butter or oil in a pan and cook onion until soft.
Add ginger-garlic paste, capsicum and tomatoes; cook until softened.
Add pav bhaji masala, chili powder and salt.
Mix in the mashed vegetables with a little water and mash together in the pan until thick and cohesive.
Simmer for 5–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, then garnish with coriander.
Toast pav buns with a little butter and serve with the bhaji.
description: Detailed pav bhaji recipe with measured ingredients and clear step-by-step instructions.

name: Sweet Potato Fries
steps: Peel sweet potatoes and cut into thin fries.
Soak briefly in cold water and dry very well.
Toss with oil and seasonings.
Arrange in a single layer.
Bake at 220°C for 25–30 minutes, turning halfway.
Serve immediately.
description: A delicious sweet potato fries recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Tomato Bruschetta
steps: Dice tomatoes and mix with basil, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Slice baguette into small pieces.
Toast bread until crisp.
Rub warm bread lightly with garlic.
Spoon tomato mixture over each piece.
Serve immediately.
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: A delicious tomato bruschetta recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Vegetable Spring Rolls
steps: Slice all vegetables into thin strips.
Stir-fry garlic and vegetables over high heat.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil and cook until the vegetables are just tender.
Cool the filling completely.
Place filling near one edge of each wrapper.
Fold sides inward and roll tightly.
Seal with flour-water paste.
Fry until crisp and golden.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: A delicious vegetable spring rolls recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Apple Crumble
steps: Peel and slice apples.
Toss apples with sugar and cinnamon and place in a baking dish.
Mix oats, flour and brown sugar.
Rub in butter until crumbly.
Spread topping over the apples.
Bake at 180°C for 30–35 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Rest for 10 minutes and serve warm.
description: A delicious apple crumble recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Banana Bread
steps: Preheat the oven to 175°C and grease a loaf pan.
Mash bananas until mostly smooth.
Mix in melted butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Add flour, baking soda and salt.
Fold gently until just combined.
Pour into the loaf pan.
Bake for 50–55 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool before slicing.
description: A delicious banana bread recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Besan Ladoo
ingredients: 2 tbsp chopped cashews or almonds, optional
steps: Heat ghee in a heavy pan over low heat.
Add besan and roast slowly, stirring continuously, until fragrant and golden; do not let it burn.
Remove from heat and allow to cool until warm, not hot.
Mix in powdered sugar, cardamom and nuts if using.
When cool enough to handle, shape into small ladoos and allow to set.
description: Detailed besan ladoo recipe with measured ingredients and clear step-by-step instructions.

name: Carrot Halwa
steps: Wash, peel and grate the carrots.
Cook carrots with milk in a heavy pan over medium heat.
Stir regularly until most of the milk evaporates.
Add sugar and continue cooking.
Add ghee and cardamom.
Cook until glossy and thick.
Garnish with toasted nuts and serve warm or chilled.
description: A delicious carrot halwa recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Cheesecake Cups
steps: Mix crushed biscuits with a tablespoon of melted butter if desired.
Beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Fold in whipped cream.
Layer biscuit crumbs into serving cups.
Add cheesecake mixture.
Top with sliced strawberries.
Chill for at least 2 hours before serving.
description: A delicious cheesecake cups recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Chocolate Brownies
steps: Preheat oven to 175°C and line a square pan.
Melt butter and let it cool slightly.
Whisk butter with sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Fold in cocoa, flour and salt.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Spread batter evenly in the pan.
Bake for 22–28 minutes; avoid overbaking.
Cool completely before cutting into squares.
description: A delicious chocolate brownies recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Chocolate Cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a cake pan.
Whisk flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Add eggs, milk, oil and vanilla and mix until smooth.
Slowly pour in hot water while mixing.
Pour the thin batter into the prepared pan.
Bake for 30–35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely before slicing or frosting.
description: A delicious chocolate cake recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup chocolate chips or chopped chocolate
steps: Preheat oven to 175°C and line a baking tray.
Cream softened butter and sugar until combined.
Beat in egg and vanilla essence, if using.
Mix flour, baking powder and salt separately, then fold into the butter mixture.
Fold in chocolate chips without overmixing.
Scoop small portions onto the tray, leaving space between them, and flatten slightly.
Bake for 10–14 minutes until edges are lightly golden. Cool on the tray before moving.
description: Detailed chocolate chip cookies recipe with measured ingredients and clear step-by-step instructions.

name: Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 3 pasteurized eggs (the recipe uses uncooked eggs)
steps: Use pasteurized eggs or pasteurized egg products for this no-cook mousse; do not substitute ordinary raw shell eggs. Keep the mousse refrigerated and serve promptly.
Melt the chocolate gently and let it cool until warm but not hot.
Separate the pasteurized eggs and whisk the yolks into the cooled chocolate.
Whip the cream until soft peaks form.
Beat the egg whites with the sugar until fluffy.
Fold the cream into the chocolate mixture, then gently fold in the egg whites.
Divide into cups, cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Keep chilled until serving.
description: A delicious chocolate mousse recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Coconut Barfi
steps: Combine coconut, condensed milk and milk in a non-stick pan.
Cook over low-medium heat while stirring.
Continue until the mixture thickens and leaves the sides.
Add cardamom and nuts.
Press into a greased tray.
Cool completely and cut into squares.
description: A delicious coconut barfi recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Coconut Ladoo
steps: Reserve a few tablespoons of coconut for coating.
Cook remaining coconut and condensed milk in a pan over low heat.
Stir continuously until the mixture thickens and leaves the sides.
Add cardamom and nuts.
Cool until comfortable to handle.
Grease your hands lightly and shape small balls.
Roll each ball in the reserved coconut and serve.
description: A delicious coconut ladoo recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Donuts
steps: Mix warm milk, sugar and yeast; leave for 5–10 minutes until foamy if using active dry yeast.
Add flour, butter, egg, salt and cardamom if using. Knead into a soft dough.
Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour.
Roll dough to about 1.5 cm thick and cut into rings.
Rest the cut donuts for 20–30 minutes.
Fry in moderately hot oil in small batches until golden on both sides and cooked through.
Drain on kitchen paper and coat with powdered sugar once slightly cooled.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: Detailed donuts recipe with measured ingredients and clear step-by-step instructions.

name: Fruit Custard
steps: Mix custard powder with a little cold milk until smooth.
Heat remaining milk with sugar.
Add the custard mixture while whisking continuously.
Cook until thick and glossy.
Cool the custard completely.
Chop the fruits into bite-sized pieces.
Fold fruit into the cold custard and chill before serving.
description: A delicious fruit custard recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Gulab Jamun
steps: Mix milk powder, flour, baking soda and ghee.
Add milk gradually and form a soft dough without over-kneading.
Rest for 10 minutes.
Mix sugar, water and cardamom and simmer for 5 minutes to make syrup.
Shape dough into small smooth balls.
Fry over low-medium heat until evenly golden.
Drain and immediately place the warm balls into warm syrup.
Soak for at least 1 hour before serving.
description: A delicious gulab jamun recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Jalebi
ingredients: Water, as needed for a thick flowing batter
steps: Mix maida, rice flour, yogurt and baking powder with enough water to make a smooth, thick flowing batter.
Cover and rest in a warm place for 6–8 hours to ferment lightly.
Boil sugar and water until slightly sticky, then add cardamom and lemon juice; keep warm.
Pour batter into a squeeze bottle or piping bag.
Pipe small spirals into moderately hot oil or ghee and fry until crisp and golden.
Drain briefly, then dip in warm syrup for 30–60 seconds.
Lift out and serve warm.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: Detailed jalebi recipe with measured ingredients and clear step-by-step instructions.

name: Mango Ice Cream
steps: Blend mango flesh into a smooth puree.
Whip cream until soft peaks form.
Fold condensed milk and mango puree into the cream.
Pour into a freezer-safe container.
Freeze for 6 hours, stirring once after the first 2 hours if possible.
Let sit for 5 minutes before scooping.
description: A delicious mango ice cream recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Mango Pudding
steps: Blend mango flesh into a smooth puree.
Bloom gelatin in water for 5 minutes.
Warm the gelatin gently until dissolved.
Mix mango puree, cream and condensed milk.
Stir in the dissolved gelatin.
Pour into serving glasses.
Chill for at least 3 hours and serve cold.
description: A delicious mango pudding recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Pistachio Kulfi
steps: Simmer milk in a heavy pot until reduced by about one-third.
Add condensed milk, sugar and cardamom.
Cook for another 5 minutes while stirring.
Cool slightly and stir in chopped pistachios.
Pour into kulfi molds.
Freeze for at least 6 hours.
Dip molds briefly in warm water to release and serve.
description: A delicious pistachio kulfi recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Rice Kheer
steps: Wash and soak rice for 15 minutes.
Bring milk to a gentle boil in a heavy pot.
Add drained rice and cook over low heat, stirring often.
Continue until the rice becomes soft and the milk thickens.
Add sugar and crushed cardamom.
Cook for another 5 minutes.
Toast cashews and raisins lightly and add them before serving.
description: A delicious rice kheer recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Tiramisu Cups
steps: Whisk mascarpone, sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Fold in whipped cream gently.
Dip biscuits briefly into cooled coffee.
Place a layer of biscuits in serving cups.
Add a layer of cream mixture.
Repeat the layers.
Dust with cocoa powder and chill for at least 2 hours.
description: A delicious tiramisu cups recipe with clear ingredients and detailed cooking instructions.

name: Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani (Dum Style)
ingredients: Pinch of saffron in 1/4 cup warm milk
Whole spices (bay leaf, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon)
steps: Marinate the chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, spices, half the fried onions, herbs and salt for at least 1 hour; keep refrigerated while marinating.
Soak the rice for 30 minutes, then boil with whole spices and salt until about 70% cooked; drain.
Layer half the rice over the raw marinated chicken in a heavy, oven-safe or stovetop pot.
Add mint, coriander, fried onions and ghee, then the remaining rice.
Drizzle saffron milk over the top.
Seal the pot tightly. Cook on medium heat for 5 minutes, then on very low heat for about 35 minutes; avoid opening it repeatedly.
Check the chicken in several thick pieces with a food thermometer; it must reach 74°C (165°F). If needed, continue cooking until it does. Rest for 10 minutes, gently mix and serve hot with raita.
description: Fragrant dum-cooked biryani with marinated chicken, saffron and layered basmati rice.

name: Malabar Chicken Biryani
steps: Fry cashews and raisins in ghee and set aside, then fry onions until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste, green chilies, tomatoes and spices; cook until the masala thickens.
Add chicken, salt and a splash of water. Cover and cook until the chicken is tender and reaches 74°C (165°F) in the thickest pieces.
Stir in lemon juice, mint and coriander.
Boil the rice with whole spices and salt until about 80% cooked, then drain.
Layer the rice and chicken masala in a pot, topping with fried onions, nuts and ghee.
Cover tightly and steam on low for 15–20 minutes. Rest for 5–10 minutes, then serve hot.
description: Kerala's beloved Thalassery-style biryani using short-grain kaima rice and mildly spiced masala.

name: Mutton Biryani (Dum Style)
steps: Marinate the mutton with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, spices, half the fried onions and salt for 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Pressure-cook the mutton with its marinade and a little water until nearly tender; cooking time varies by cut and cooker, so do not rely on whistle count alone.
Parboil the soaked rice with whole spices until about 70% cooked, then drain.
Layer the mutton and rice in a heavy pot with herbs, onions, ghee and saffron milk.
Seal and cook on very low heat for about 20–30 minutes, until the mutton is fully tender and the rice is cooked.
Rest for 10 minutes, mix gently and serve hot.

Food safety: cook meat thoroughly. For ground beef or mutton, verify an internal temperature of at least 71°C (160°F); for whole pieces in curries, cook until fully tender and steaming hot throughout.
description: Slow-cooked tender mutton layered with aromatic rice, fried onions and whole spices.

name: Egg Biryani (Spiced Egg)
steps: Lightly fry the boiled eggs with a pinch of turmeric and chili until golden and set aside
Fry onions until brown, then add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes
Add yogurt, spices and salt and cook until oil separates
Boil the rice until 70% cooked and drain
Layer the masala, eggs and rice with herbs
Cover and steam on low for 15 minutes
Serve hot with raita
Food safety: cook the egg mixture until fully set with no raw, liquid egg remaining. Keep raw egg and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat foods.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: A quick and satisfying biryani with spiced boiled eggs layered through fragrant rice.

name: Vegetable Biryani (Mixed Vegetables)
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, peas, cauliflower)
steps: Cook the vegetables with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, spices and salt until just tender
Boil the soaked rice with whole spices until 70% cooked and drain
Layer vegetables and rice in a pot with herbs, fried onions and ghee
Cover tightly and cook on low for 20 minutes
Fluff gently and serve with raita
description: Colorful mixed vegetables and basmati rice cooked together with warm biryani spices.

name: Prawn Biryani
steps: Marinate the cleaned prawns with turmeric, chili powder, lemon juice and salt for 15 minutes; keep refrigerated.
Fry onions until golden, then add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes.
Add the remaining spices and prawns. Cook just until the prawns turn opaque and begin to curl; avoid prolonged cooking.
Parboil the rice until about 70% cooked and drain.
Layer the prawn masala and rice with herbs and ghee.
Cover and steam on very low heat for about 8–10 minutes, just until the rice is cooked. Check that the prawns are fully cooked (about 63°C/145°F), then serve hot.
description: Juicy prawns tossed in spicy masala and layered with fragrant basmati rice.

name: Beef Biryani (Slow-Cooked)
steps: Pressure-cook the beef with ginger-garlic paste, spices, tomatoes, yogurt and salt until fork-tender; add water as needed and follow the cooker instructions.
Reduce the gravy until thick.
Parboil the rice with whole spices until about 75% cooked, then drain.
Layer the beef and rice with fried onions, herbs and ghee.
Seal and cook on very low heat for about 20–25 minutes, until the rice is tender and the beef is hot throughout.
Rest briefly and serve hot.

Food safety: cook meat thoroughly. For ground beef or mutton, verify an internal temperature of at least 71°C (160°F); for whole pieces in curries, cook until fully tender and steaming hot throughout.
description: A rich, robust biryani with slow-cooked spiced beef and long-grain rice.

name: Chicken Tikka Biryani
steps: Marinate the chicken with yogurt and tandoori masala, then grill or pan-sear until charred and the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F).
Parboil the rice with whole spices until about 70% cooked, then drain.
Layer the cooked chicken tikka and rice in a pot with fried onions, herbs and ghee.
Drizzle saffron milk on top.
Cover and steam on very low heat for 10–15 minutes, until the rice is cooked; rest for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with raita and salad.
description: Smoky grilled chicken tikka folded into saffron-scented rice.

name: Butter Chicken (Creamy Tomato Gravy)
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, chili powder and salt for 30 minutes in the refrigerator, then pan-sear until browned.
Melt butter, add ginger-garlic paste and tomato puree, and cook for about 12 minutes.
Blend the sauce until smooth and return it to the pan.
Add the chicken, garam masala and sugar. Simmer until the thickest chicken pieces reach 74°C (165°F).
Stir in cream and crushed kasuri methi; warm gently without boiling hard.
Serve hot with naan or rice.
description: Creamy tomato-based curry with tender chicken, a North Indian favorite.

name: Paneer Butter Masala (Cashew Gravy)
steps: Boil tomatoes, onion and cashews together and blend to a smooth puree
Heat butter and sauté ginger-garlic paste
Add puree, chili powder and salt and cook 10 minutes
Add paneer, garam masala and a little water and simmer 5 minutes
Finish with cream and kasuri methi
Serve with roti or naan
description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a rich buttery tomato gravy.

name: Dal Tadka (Toor Dal)
steps: Pressure cook the dal with turmeric and salt until soft and mash lightly
Heat ghee and fry cumin, garlic and red chilies
Add onion and tomato and cook until soft
Pour the tempering over the dal and simmer 5 minutes
Garnish with coriander and serve with rice
Pressure-cooker safety: follow the cooker manufacturer's instructions and let pressure release fully before opening; never force the lid open.
description: Comforting yellow lentils finished with a sizzling garlic and cumin tempering.

name: Chole Masala
steps: Fry onions until golden and add ginger-garlic paste
Add tomatoes and cook until oil separates
Stir in the spices and cook 2 minutes
Add chickpeas and 1 cup water and simmer 20 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken
Garnish with coriander and serve
description: Spiced chickpea curry that pairs perfectly with bhatura or rice.

name: Palak Paneer (Creamy Spinach Gravy)
steps: Blanch spinach for 2 minutes, cool in cold water and blend to a puree
Fry cumin, garlic and onion until golden, then add tomatoes
Add the spinach puree, garam masala and salt and simmer 5 minutes
Add paneer cubes and cook 3 minutes
Finish with cream and serve
description: Paneer in a silky, lightly spiced spinach gravy.

name: Aloo Paratha
steps: Knead flour with water and salt into a soft dough and rest 15 minutes
Mash potatoes with spices and coriander
Roll a dough ball, fill with potato and seal
Roll out gently into a flat circle
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee until golden on both sides
Serve with curd or pickle
description: Whole wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced mashed potato.

name: Veg Fried Rice
steps: Use cooked rice that was cooled quickly and refrigerated promptly; keep it refrigerated until frying. Do not use rice left at room temperature for a long time.
Heat oil in a wok on high heat.
Fry garlic and vegetables for 2–3 minutes so they stay slightly crunchy.
Add the cold rice, soy sauce, pepper and salt.
