Toss until the rice is steaming hot throughout, breaking up any clumps.
Garnish with spring onion greens and serve immediately.
description: Wok-tossed rice with crisp vegetables and soy sauce.

name: Chicken Fried Rice (Smoky Wok Style)
steps: Use cooked rice that was cooled quickly and refrigerated promptly; keep it refrigerated until frying. Do not use rice left at room temperature for a long time.
Stir-fry the chicken with salt and pepper until the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F), then set aside.
Scramble the eggs until fully set and set aside.
Fry garlic and vegetables on high heat.
Add the rice, cooked chicken, egg and soy sauce.
Toss until the rice is steaming hot throughout, then serve immediately.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: Egg and chicken fried rice with a smoky wok flavor.

name: Hakka Noodles
steps: Boil noodles until al dente, drain and toss with a little oil
Fry garlic and vegetables on high heat for 2 minutes
Add soy sauce, chili sauce, vinegar, salt and pepper
Add noodles and toss for 2-3 minutes
Serve immediately
description: Stir-fried noodles with vegetables in a savory soy-chili sauce.

name: Chilli Chicken
ingredients: 1 tbsp cornflour for the sauce slurry
steps: Coat the chicken with egg, cornflour, salt and pepper. Deep-fry in batches until golden and the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F); drain.
Stir-fry garlic, chilies, onion and capsicum on high heat.
Add soy sauce, chili sauce and vinegar.
Mix the remaining cornflour with the 1/4 cup water to make a smooth slurry. Add it to the pan and cook until the sauce thickens.
Add the fried chicken and toss until glossy and hot. Serve immediately.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: Crispy chicken tossed with peppers and onions in a tangy Indo-Chinese sauce.

name: Veg Manchurian
steps: Mix vegetables, flour, 1 tbsp cornflour and seasoning and shape into balls
Deep fry until golden
Sauté garlic and ginger, then add soy and chili sauce
Add 1 cup water and thicken with cornflour slurry
Add the balls, toss and garnish with spring onion
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: Fried vegetable dumplings coated in a rich garlic-soy gravy.

name: Chicken Sweet Corn Soup
steps: Bring the chicken stock to a boil with the corn and raw chicken; simmer until the chicken reaches 74°C (165°F) in the thickest piece and is cooked through.
Shred or finely chop the cooked chicken if needed, then return it to the soup.
Season with soy sauce, pepper and salt.
Stir in the cornflour slurry and simmer until slightly thick.
Pour the beaten egg in a slow stream while stirring, then cook until the egg is fully set.
Serve hot.
description: A light, warming soup with corn, chicken and silky egg ribbons.

name: Chicken Mandi
steps: Rub the chicken with mandi spice, salt and ghee
Roast or cook it until tender, lightly smoky and the thickest part reaches 74°C (165°F) internally
Sauté rice with whole spices, then cook in stock with dried lime until fluffy
Layer rice on a platter and top with the chicken
Garnish with fried raisins and almonds and serve with tomato chili sauce
description: Yemeni-style tender chicken over smoky spiced rice.

name: Chicken Shawarma
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, lemon, garlic and spices for at least 2 hours
Cook on a hot grill or pan until charred and the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F) internally
Slice thinly
Warm the pita and spread with garlic sauce
Fill with chicken, pickles, lettuce and tomato
Roll tightly and toast lightly
description: Juicy spiced chicken wrapped with garlic sauce and pickles.

name: Hummus
steps: Blend tahini and lemon juice for 1 minute
Add garlic, cumin and salt and blend again
Add chickpeas and blend until smooth, adding ice water as needed
Spread on a plate and drizzle with olive oil and paprika
description: Silky chickpea and tahini dip, perfect with pita.

name: Falafel
steps: Soak dried chickpeas overnight in the refrigerator, then drain and rinse them; do not cook them before blending for this falafel style.
Blend with onion, garlic, herbs and spices into a coarse paste
Stir in baking soda and rest 15 minutes
Shape into small patties
Fry in small batches until browned and fully cooked through in the center; do not serve falafel with a raw or cold center. Drain and serve with tahini sauce.
description: Crispy herbed chickpea fritters with a fluffy center.

name: Kabsa
steps: Brown the chicken or lamb with onions and whole spices.
Add tomatoes, tomato paste, kabsa spice and water. Cover and cook until the meat is tender; if using chicken, check that the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F).
Remove the cooked meat and keep it covered. Add the soaked rice to the cooking stock and cook covered until fluffy and fully tender.
Serve the rice topped with the meat, raisins and toasted almonds.
description: Saudi-style spiced rice with meat, tomatoes and warm aromatic spices.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Sauté the onion, pepper and garlic in olive oil until softened.
Add the spices and tomatoes and simmer for about 12 minutes, until the sauce is thick.
Make wells in the sauce and crack the eggs into them.
Cover and cook until both the egg whites and yolks are fully set. For anyone choosing runny eggs, use pasteurized eggs and understand that fully set eggs are the safer option.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot with bread.
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.

name: Appam with Stew
ingredients: Oil for greasing the appam pan
steps: Drain the soaked rice, then grind it with the cooked rice and grated coconut into a smooth batter, adding water as needed.
Mix in the yeast, sugar and a little salt. Cover and ferment in a warm place until bubbly and risen, usually 6–8 hours.
For the stew, heat coconut oil in a saucepan and gently sauté the onion, green chilies, curry leaves, cinnamon and cloves.
Add the potato, carrot and green beans, then pour in the thin coconut milk.
Cover and simmer until the vegetables are tender, adding a little water if needed.
Stir in the thick coconut milk and warm gently without letting it boil hard. Adjust salt.
Heat and lightly grease an appam pan. Pour in a ladle of batter and swirl the pan so the batter coats the sides and leaves a thicker center.
Cover and cook for about 2–3 minutes, until the edges are lacy and the center is fluffy and cooked.
Repeat with the remaining batter and serve the appam hot with the coconut vegetable stew.

Food safety: use freshly cooked rice or rice cooled promptly and kept refrigerated; never use rice left at room temperature for a long time. Reheat until steaming hot throughout and serve immediately.
description: Soft, lacy Kerala appam served with a mild coconut-milk vegetable stew.

name: Puttu and Kadala Curry
ingredients: 1 cup grated coconut, for layering puttu
1/2 cup warm water, or as needed
steps: Mix the puttu flour with salt and sprinkle warm water over it gradually, rubbing with your fingertips until the flour is moist and crumbly rather than doughy.
Layer the puttu maker with a little grated coconut, the moistened flour and more coconut; repeat, finishing with coconut.
Steam for 8–10 minutes, or until the puttu is hot and cooked through.
For the kadala curry, heat coconut oil in a pan and let the mustard seeds splutter. Add curry leaves, green chilies, onion and ginger-garlic paste; sauté until softened.
Add the tomato, coriander powder, chili powder, turmeric and garam masala. Cook until the tomato softens.
Add the cooked black chickpeas, grated coconut and enough water to make a thick curry. Simmer for 10–15 minutes, adding water if needed.
Season to taste and serve the hot puttu with the kadala curry.
description: Steamed rice-and-coconut cylinders with spicy black chickpea curry.

name: Kerala Beef Fry
steps: Pressure cook beef with spices, ginger-garlic paste and salt until tender
Fry coconut slices in coconut oil until golden
Add onions and curry leaves and sauté until brown
Add the beef and roast on medium heat until dry and dark
Finish with black pepper and serve

Food safety: cook meat thoroughly. For ground beef or mutton, verify an internal temperature of at least 71°C (160°F); for whole pieces in curries, cook until fully tender and steaming hot throughout.
Pressure-cooker safety: follow the cooker manufacturer's instructions and let pressure release fully before opening; never force the lid open.
description: Slow-roasted beef with coconut slices, curry leaves and black pepper.

name: Karimeen Pollichathu
steps: Marinate the cleaned fish with chili powder, turmeric, lemon juice and salt.
Shallow-fry the fish briefly on both sides; it will finish cooking in the banana-leaf parcel.
Cook onions, ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes and spices into a thick masala.
Place some masala on a banana leaf, lay the fish on it and cover with the remaining masala. Wrap securely.
Pan-cook over medium-low heat, turning carefully, until the fish is opaque and flakes easily; check the center reaches 63°C (145°F). Cooking time depends on the fish's thickness.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: Pearl spot fish marinated in masala, wrapped in banana leaf and pan-cooked.

name: Unniyappam
steps: Mix flour, jaggery syrup and mashed banana into a thick batter
Add coconut, cardamom and baking soda
Rest 30 minutes
Heat ghee in an appam pan
Pour batter into each mold and fry until dark golden on all sides
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: Sweet fried rice-and-jaggery balls with coconut bits and cardamom.

name: Chicken Samosa (Minced Chicken)
steps: Cook the minced chicken with onion, ginger-garlic paste and spices, breaking it into small pieces, until it reaches 74°C (165°F) and no pink remains.
Cool the fully cooked filling promptly in a shallow dish; refrigerate it if not assembling immediately and do not leave it at room temperature for more than 2 hours (1 hour in hot weather).
Fold the pastry sheets into cones and fill with the cooled chicken mixture.
Seal the edges with flour paste.
Deep-fry in batches until golden and crisp, turning as needed. Serve hot.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
description: Crisp pastry triangles stuffed with spiced minced chicken.

name: Masala Chai
steps: Boil water with crushed ginger and cardamom
Add tea leaves and simmer 2 minutes
Pour in milk and sugar
Bring to a boil and simmer 2 minutes
Strain and serve hot
description: Strong Indian tea simmered with ginger, cardamom and milk.

name: Mango Lassi
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender
Blend until smooth and frothy
Serve chilled
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: A thick, cooling yogurt drink with ripe mango.

name: Fresh Lime Soda
steps: Squeeze the lime juice into glasses
Add sugar, salt and mint and stir
Add ice and top with soda
Stir gently and serve
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: A sparkling sweet-and-salty lime refresher.

name: Sulaimani
steps: Boil water with cloves and cardamom
Add tea leaves and steep 2 minutes
Strain into cups and add sugar
Squeeze in lemon juice and add mint
description: Malabar's spiced black tea with lemon and a hint of mint.

name: Cold Coffee
steps: Dissolve coffee in 2 tbsp warm water
Blend with milk, sugar and ice until frothy
Pour into glasses and add ice cream
Drizzle chocolate syrup and serve
description: Creamy iced coffee blended with milk and ice cream.

name: Falooda
steps: Layer rose syrup, basil seeds, sev and jelly in tall glasses
Slowly pour cold milk over the top
Top with ice cream and chopped nuts
Serve with a long spoon
description: A layered dessert-drink with rose syrup, vermicelli, basil seeds and ice cream.

name: Classic Chicken Burger
ingredients: 1 small onion, thinly sliced into rings
steps: In a mixing bowl, combine minced chicken with ginger-garlic paste, black pepper powder, chili powder, and salt. Mix thoroughly to blend the spices.
Divide the seasoned chicken mixture into 2 equal portions and shape them into firm round patties slightly wider than your burger buns.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a non-stick frying pan or skillet over medium heat.
Place the chicken patties in the pan and pan-fry for 4 to 5 minutes on each side until golden brown and the center reaches 74°C (165°F) and is cooked completely through.
Slice the burger buns horizontally and toast them lightly on a dry pan until golden and warm.
Mix mayonnaise and tomato ketchup together in a small bowl to create a creamy burger sauce.
Assemble the burgers by spreading the sauce on both halves of the toasted buns.
Place crisp lettuce or shredded cabbage on the bottom bun, followed by a hot cooked chicken patty, a cheese slice, sliced tomatoes, and onion rings.
Secure with the top bun and serve hot alongside crispy french fries.
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: Juicy, spiced pan-fried chicken patty burger with creamy mayonnaise, fresh veggies, and toasted buns using ingredients easily found in local Indian and Kerala supermarkets.

name: Crispy Veg Cheese Roll
ingredients: 1/2 cup boiled green peas and carrots
1/2 cup grated processed cheese (Amul or similar)
2 tbsp tomato ketchup or mint chutney
1 tbsp butter or ghee for pan roasting
steps: In a large bowl, mix the boiled mashed potatoes, boiled green peas, and carrots together.
Add chaat masala, garam masala, red chili powder, and salt to the vegetable mixture, then mix well until smooth and uniform.
Divide the potato filling into equal portions and shape them into cylindrical logs.
Warm the wheat rotis or plain parathas on a hot tawa with a little butter until soft and pliable.
Spread tomato ketchup or mint chutney down the center of each warm roti.
Place a potato cylinder in the middle, top generously with grated processed cheese and sliced onions.
Roll the roti tightly around the filling, wrapping the bottom half tightly with foil or tissue paper for a firm grip.
Lightly toast the rolled wrap on the tawa for 1 minute until the cheese melts inside.
Serve hot and crispy.
description: A delightful street-style veggie cheese roll packed with spiced potatoes, melted cheese, and fresh onions, crafted with local supermarket ingredients.

name: Spicy Peri Peri French Fries
ingredients: 3 large potatoes, peeled and cut into long uniform fingers
2 cups refined oil for deep frying
1.5 tsp peri peri masala powder (readymade store-bought)
steps: Wash and peel the potatoes, then cut them into clean, uniform french fry strips.
Soak the potato strips in cold water with 1/2 teaspoon of salt for 15 minutes to remove excess starch, then pat them completely dry with a clean kitchen towel.
Heat refined oil in a deep kadai or frying pan over medium-high flame.
Drop the potato fingers into the hot oil in batches and deep-fry for about 6 to 7 minutes until pale golden and partially cooked. Remove and drain on paper towels.
Let the first-fried potatoes rest for about 5 minutes while you maintain a safe, steady frying temperature; keep them away from water and dry surfaces.
Transfer the hot, crispy fries immediately to a wide bowl.
Sprinkle peri peri masala powder and chaat masala generously over the hot fries.
Toss the bowl vigorously to coat every single fry evenly with the spice blend.
Serve piping hot with tomato ketchup or garlic mayonnaise.
description: Ultra-crispy double-fried potato fries tossed in fiery peri peri seasoning for that perfect restaurant-style fast food experience.

name: Classic Creamy White Sauce Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 cup boiled sweet corn and chopped capsicum
1/2 tsp mixed Italian herbs or oregano
Salt and freshly crushed black pepper to taste
steps: Bring 4 cups of water to a rolling boil with 1 teaspoon of salt and a few drops of oil. Add the pasta and cook until al dente (firm to the bite), then drain and set aside.
Heat butter in a saucepan over medium heat and sauté the minced garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add maida (all-purpose flour) to the melted butter and stir continuously for 1 to 2 minutes on low flame until aromatic without browning.
Slowly pour in room temperature milk a little at a time while whisking vigorously to prevent any lumps from forming.
Simmer the white sauce on low heat, stirring constantly, until it thickens smoothly to coat the back of a spoon.
Add boiled sweet corn, chopped capsicum, Italian herbs, chili flakes, black pepper, and salt to the sauce.
Stir in the grated processed cheese until completely melted into a rich, creamy cheese sauce.
Add the boiled pasta into the white sauce and toss gently until every piece is coated thoroughly.
Serve hot immediately, garnished with an extra pinch of herbs and chili flakes.
description: A rich, creamy white sauce pasta loaded with sweet corn and capsicum using pantry-friendly ingredients from any Indian or Kerala supermarket.

name: Crispy Zinger Chicken Strip Wrap
ingredients: 2 large frozen or fresh boneless chicken breast fillets, cut into long strips
1 tbsp hot garlic sauce or Schezwan sauce
steps: Marinate the chicken strips with ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder and salt for 15 minutes in the refrigerator.
In a bowl, mix maida, cornflour and a pinch of salt with a little water to make a smooth batter.
Beat the egg in a separate bowl. Place crushed cornflakes in a third plate.
Coat each chicken strip in the batter, dip in the beaten egg, then press into the crushed cornflakes.
Heat oil in a deep pan. Fry the strips in small batches until crisp and golden and the thickest parts reach 74°C (165°F); do not rely on color alone. Drain on paper towels.
Warm the tortillas or soft chapatis on a tawa.
Mix the mayonnaise and hot garlic sauce in a small bowl.
Spread the sauce across the center of each tortilla.
Add shredded lettuce and the cooked chicken strips.
Drizzle with extra sauce, fold in the sides and roll up securely.
Serve warm.
Hot-oil safety: dry ingredients thoroughly before frying, lower them gently, fry in small batches, and never add water to hot oil or leave hot oil unattended.
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: Crunchy golden fried chicken strips rolled in soft tortillas with spicy garlic mayo and fresh lettuce, perfect for a fast-food night at home.

name: 60-Second Choco-Banana Sandwich
steps: Spread the chocolate spread over one slice of bread.
Peel and quickly slice the banana into thin rounds.
Arrange the banana on the bread and cover with the second slice.
Cut in half and serve immediately.
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: ⭐ Friends' Recommendation — A no-cook chocolate and banana sandwich made with everyday ingredients. Use ready-to-eat bread and spread; assemble and serve immediately.

name: 60-Second Banana Peanut Butter Bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a small bowl.
Peel and slice the banana over the yogurt.
Add the peanut butter on top and swirl it through slightly.
Serve immediately.
Food safety: wash fresh fruit, vegetables and herbs under clean running water before cutting or serving; wash hands and use clean utensils.
description: ⭐ Friends' Recommendation — A creamy no-cook snack with banana, ready-to-eat yogurt and peanut butter. Slice, swirl and serve immediately.

name: 60-Second Spicy Pori Crunch
steps: Add the pori and roasted peanuts to a bowl.
Sprinkle in the chilli powder and salt.
Add lemon juice and toss everything together.
Eat immediately while the pori is crunchy.
description: ⭐ Friends' Recommendation — A Kerala-friendly crunchy snack made with ready-to-eat pori, roasted peanuts, lemon and simple spices. Mix and eat immediately to keep it crunchy.

name: 60-Second Chocolate Biscuit Cup
ingredients: 2 tbsp milk, adding a little more only if needed
steps: Break the biscuits into a cup or small bowl.
Crush them with the back of a spoon.
Add the milk gradually and mix until soft and spoonable.
Serve immediately as a quick biscuit dessert.
description: ⭐ Friends' Recommendation — A quick no-cook chocolate biscuit cup made with chocolate biscuits and a little milk. Crush, mix and serve immediately.

name: 60-Second Peanut Butter Date Bites
steps: Check the dates and remove the pits if they have not already been removed.
Open each date gently.
Fill each date with a little peanut butter.
Arrange on a plate and serve.
description: ⭐ Friends' Recommendation — Sweet, chewy dates filled with peanut butter. Use soft, already-pitted dates so the snack can be assembled quickly.
